caption: The drawing depicts a single, brown leather doctor's bag set against a plain, light beige background. The bag is rectangular with rounded corners and features two sturdy handles attached to metal rings at the top. The leather is rendered in shades of brown and reddish-brown, showing wear and texture, with visible seams, stitching, and creases. There are several metallic fixtures on the bag, including two circular locks and an oval-shaped metal plate on the front, as well as a clasp mechanism at the top for opening and closing the bag. The shadowing and highlights indicate a light source coming from the upper left, emphasizing the three-dimensional aspect of the bag. There is a handwritten signature in the lower right corner that reads "Albert Avis Allen K.C. MO." The composition is centered, with the bag occupying the middle of the sheet and no other objects present.
title: Hand Bag
